title: Tribonacci
statement: The Tribonacci sequence is T(0) = 0, T(1) = 1, T(2) = 1, and T(n) = T(n - 1) + T(n - 2) + T(n - 3) for n >= 3. Return T(n).
hints: The recurrence uses three previous terms.
Three rolling variables compute the sequence in constant space.

approaches.name: Rolling sum
approaches.explanation: Shift a window of three terms.

editorial: This is the same idea as Fibonacci with one extra term. Keep a, b, and c. The next value is their sum, then slide the window. Return early for n < 3 so the loop has a legal start.

examples.explanation: A larger term, still exact in integers.
